name: ArtiSys SEO
boundary: Portable SEO configuration, technical artifact generation, deterministic auditing, dashboard view-models and an optional Search Console read-only adapter. Hosting, persistence, OAuth credentials, token refresh and product content stay in the consumer.
limitations: Search Console network requests only occur when its explicit adapter is used.
OAuth credentials and token refresh are not stored or implemented by the core; consumers inject getAccessToken().
Analytics, tracking, hosting and persistence remain outside this phase.
